consentText.en: Allow ModelPlan on this user account—App, plugins and all CLI copies—to read usage for the selected tools using their existing sign-in, through native readers or audited standard CodexBar access. CodexBar is downloaded automatically with a verified checksum; you do not install it. Your credential is sent only to the provider hosts shown for that tool; it is never sent to ModelPlan servers or stored by ModelPlan. macOS may ask for Keychain access for our own readers; standard CodexBar access has Keychain and browser-cookie import disabled. Browser-session access is excluded and requires separate per-provider consent. You can turn this off in Settings.
consentText.zh: 允许此用户账户下的 ModelPlan App、插件和所有 CLI 副本，使用所选工具已有的登录，通过原生读取器或经审计的标准 CodexBar 访问读取用量。CodexBar 会自动下载并校验校验和，无需自行安装。凭据仅发送至各工具所列的服务商主机，绝不发送至 ModelPlan 服务器，也不由 ModelPlan 保存。macOS 可能为原生读取器请求钥匙串访问权限；标准 CodexBar 访问禁用钥匙串和浏览器 Cookie 导入。浏览器会话访问不在本次授权范围内，须按服务商单独授权。可随时在设置中关闭。
